name: Jászfényszaru (Hungary)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the town arms of Jászfényszaru (a crowned red shield with a white patriarchal cross within a green wreath) above the name JÁSZFÉNYSZARU in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Jászfényszaru arms with crown and wreath
